name: oneshot_help
description: Read OneShot's web search API guide, including request fields and synchronous response format. Fetched on demand and cached for this process. Treazure handles payments; legacy payment-header examples in the guide are not setup steps. Any configured document limit is reported explicitly.

name: oneshot_search
description: Search the web and return structured results inline, without job polling. Vendor-listed price: $0.001 per request; the live x402 challenge and configured payment cap are authoritative. query is 1–500 characters; max_results is 1–20 (default 5). Prefer the smallest useful result count.
